basic_details.job_title: DCPU Araria Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Nurse (Female) (नर्स (महिला)), unreserved (UR), is to be filled on a contract basis at the Specialised Adoption Agency (विशिष्ट दत्तक ग्रहण संस्थान, SAA), Araria, run by the District Child Protection Unit, Collectorate, Araria (समाहरणालय, अररिया (जिला बाल संरक्षण इकाई)) under the Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. Candidates send the application in the prescribed form only by speed post or registered post to the Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit, Collectorate Campus, Araria, Bihar, PIN 854311, within 30 days from the date the advertisement is published

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days of the advertisement's newspaper publication – about 5 December 2026 (30 days from 5 November 2026)
important_dates.interview_date: To be displayed on nic Araria and the office notice board

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go only by speed post or registered post to this address: Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit, Collectorate Campus, Araria, Bihar, PIN Code-854311.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Nurse (Female), in the unreserved (UR) category, at a pay of Rs. 11916/- per month. Essential qualification: Intermediate with G.N.M / Bachelor degree in nursing from a Government / Indian Nursing Council recognized nursing institution. Experience: A minimum of 1 year experience in hospital/health facility. Age limit: Up to 45 years; the maximum age must be 45 years as on 01.11.2026. Gender: The post is advertised as Nurse (Female). Reservation: Reservation benefit is available only to candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar, that is, natives of Bihar. Residents of other states get no reservation benefit. Reservation must be claimed in the marked column of the application form, and only the permanent address filled in the application is accepted for reservation. Pay: Rs. 11916/- per month. The notice names no allowances on top of this amount. Candidates should check the full eligibility for the Nurse (Female) post in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of the following go with the application form: Photograph (a self-attested passport size colour photograph pasted on the form) All educational qualification certificates Mark sheets Experience certificate Caste certificate (for the benefit of reservation) Residential certificate

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DCPU Araria Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Nurse (Female), in the UR category, at the Specialised Adoption Agency (SAA), Araria.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Araria Nurse (Female) post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the newspaper, which comes to about 5 December 2026 if counted from 5 November 2026; applications after this limit will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the SAA Araria Nurse (Female) post?
faq.answer: Intermediate with G.N.M / Bachelor degree in nursing from a Government / Indian Nursing Council recognized nursing institution, plus a minimum of 1 year experience in hospital/health facility.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DCPU Araria Nurse (Female) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 45 years, with the maximum age of 45 years counted as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the DCPU Araria Nurse (Female)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 11916/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DCPU Araria Nurse (Female) post?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form with self-attested copies of the documents only by speed post or registered post to the Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit, Collectorate Campus, Araria, Bihar, PIN Code-854311.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the DCPU Araria Nurse application form?
faq.answer: The prescribed form is available on the District Administration, Araria website (nic Araria) and is printed as page 3 of the notice; applications not in this form will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write in bold letters that it is an application for selection in "विशिष्ट दत्तक ग्रहण संस्थान, अररिया" (Specialised Adoption Agency, Araria), along with the name of the post applied for.

faq.question: Q9. How will the SAA Araria Nurse (Female) be selected?
faq.answer: A Selection Committee will select candidates through educational qualification, interview and other means, and original certificates must be brought for verification on the interview date.

faq.question: Q10. Is the DCPU Araria Nurse (Female) job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on contract and fully temporary; staff will not be treated as government servants and cannot claim regularisation in government service.
